nom: La Roche-Posay - Hyalu B5 - Crème Contour des Yeux Anti-Rides qui Hydrate, Repulpe et Lisse les Signes de l’âge - Soin des Yeux Enrichi en Acide Hyaluronique et Vitamine B5 - Pour Tous Types de Peaux

avis.texte: je le connaissais déjà mais il faut mettre le sérum contour des yeux pour un résultat optimal
Après utilisation matin et soir après la peau nettoyée, on sent une bonne hydratation. Je recommande le produit.
J'ai arrêté au bout de 2 applications = picotements, rougeurs
Für meine Haut ist super, keine schlimme Nebenwirkungen, brennt nicht, Juckreiz ist auch nicht dabei. Sehr zu empfehlen!
Very good product. Really bought back to balance my dry sore and red skin around my eyes which was due to a lesser moisturising product and the weather. Would recommend to lift eyelids too

avis.titre: Good product, I'd expect more moisture power, but it's not bad
avis.texte: Nice product. I wish they made a more powerful version with stronger calming and moisturizing properties. I didn't buy it for wrinkles, maybe I'll be preventing them by using this product as well. Nice moisturized for the eyelids. They look as if they were tinted but I didn't feel any kind of coverage. Didn't expect it either, of course. I assume people who use makeup would be applying something on top of it anyways.
